simcal_report — SIMCAL report op

• Data kinds: calresult → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.simcal_report(result=None) -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import simcalcheck; simcalcheck.simcal_report(result=None) -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opssimcal.get("simcal_report"))

उपयोग

calibration की एक तालिका: हर knob का मान, इकाई, interval और वर्ग, gates, और अस्वीकृति के कारण।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

rows — one dict per knob (knob, unit, scale, value or None, std, interval from the uncertainty or the profile, class = estimated / fixed / undetermined with reason); combos — determined combinations; gates — every check that was run with pass/fail; errors — train / holdout / locked reduced chi^2; text — the same as plain lines. Reports what is there: a check that was not run is listed as not run, never as passed.
